# About
> The Crimson Bench is a global executive consulting firm founded in New York City in 2002. We deploy 25,000+ Ivy League-educated fractional C-suite executives and 150,000+ global consultants — including scientists, engineers, and ex-military — to organizations within 48 hours at transparent flat-rate pricing.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2002, New York City
- Network: 25,000+ Ivy League C-suite executives; 150,000+ total global consultants
- Roles: Fractional CEO, CFO, CTO, COO, CRO, CMO, CHRO, CISO
- Deployment SLA: 48 hours
- Pricing: Flat-rate, no marketplace markup
- Cancellation: 14-day no-cause
- Mandates: 24,000+ since founding
